listing.name: Hot Shots Tennis: Get a Grip — Nakagawa Recomp (Jstar269)
listing.original_game_title: Hot Shots Tennis: Get a Grip
listing.summary: Experimental project. The public normal-ISO procedure is labelled Boots and reaches only the stated boundary. The compatibility guide separately says a public checkout can build and play a package with your decrypted inputs and local manifest. A private developer build reaches a 3D match with sound. These are distinct setup and test results. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA UCUS98701 ISO, decrypted EBOOT.elf and required decrypted modules with the local title manifest. Optional PSPPGF fonts must also come from your own files. Decryption tools are not included; PGD/amctrl-protected data is rejected.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build the Windows 11 x64 player and local package from source using your own inputs and the title manifest. A ready-to-run release is not available through this guide. Setup directly from a raw ISO without the manifest or developer toolchain is still in development.

warnings: The public normal-ISO procedure is labelled Boots and reaches only the stated boundary. The compatibility guide separately says a public checkout can build and play a package with your decrypted inputs and local manifest. A private developer build reaches a 3D match with sound. These are distinct setup and test results.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
